{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Filter for completed orders (not refunded)
completed_orders = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")

# Final answer: completed orders
completed_count = len(completed_orders)
completed_count"}
